seen: A roadside farm stall at sunset. A woman in a cream tee and khaki shorts carrying a big watermelon under one arm to her car. A small green and yellow building with a corrugated lean-to: wooden crates of watermelons, spanspek, tomatoes and apples, and a big glass dispenser of iced water with a tap and glasses on the counter. Empty tar road, dry veld and hills, orange-pink sunset.
alreadyKept: Nobody drives past a stall like that on a day like this.

seen: A modern white house's back lawn at golden sunset. A man in a grey tee and shorts and a small girl in a purple swimming costume standing in a lawn sprinkler's spray with their arms out, both laughing, drenched, backlit so every droplet glows gold. Agapanthus in purple flower along the border, a timber deck in the foreground, warm-lit interior behind, pines beyond.
alreadyKept: That grass has been too hot to stand on since about eleven this morning.
Thursday, and this is the first time all day either of them has been cool.
